A dataset has a mean μ, median M, and mode m, following the empirical formula m = 3M − 2μm. Each data point x undergoes a linear transformation given by x′ = kx + d, where k and d are constants. The transformed dataset has a new mean μ′, median M′, and mode m′. Which of the following options correctly represents μ′, M′, and m′ while ensuring that the empirical relationship remains valid?

options.text: μ′ = kμ + d, M′ = kM + d, m′ = km + d
μ′ = kμ, M′ = kM + d, m′ = km + d
μ′ = kμ + d, M′ = kM + d, m′ = k(m + d)
μ′ = kμ + d, M′ = kM, m′ = km + d

questions.key_answer: μ′ = kμ + d, M′ = kM + d, m′ = km + d
